kind: C3-AT self-contained bounded arithmetic and counterchecks

recipe.vertex_labels: root 0; distinguished support 1; distinguished leaf 2; for j=0..66, center=3+4j adjacent to root, with leaves center+1, center+2, center+3

replay.evaluator: inputs/ordinary_tree_checked.py, listed and hash-verified common source
operations: delta on T-v for one distinguished-arm leaf and one claw leaf; symmetry gives all leaves

t67.scope_limit: One explicitly constructed tree and rank only. This computation neither constructs nor refutes a saturating flow; no census claim.

tree.construction: vertices 0..4 with edges 0-1,1-2,1-3,0-4; for j=0..5 add support 5+3j, edges 4-(5+3j), (5+3j)-(6+3j), (5+3j)-(7+3j)

tm_family.family: T_m, m >= 1, with the supplied polynomials P, D_arm, D_claw, q_arm, q_claw

computation.arithmetic: exact Python integers; no floating point
computation.generation_boundary: m=1,...,50; for each m, every integer p satisfying x(T_m)+2 <= p and 3p < 2 alpha(T_m)+1
computation.family_parameters: alpha(T_m)=3m+2, x(T_m) computed as the first j with Delta_j(P)<0, scanning through the zero-extended terminal rank
computation.conclusion_scope: bounded exact evidence for the displayed T_m family only, not a universal theorem

exact_compensation_example.selector: both arm and claw leaf orbits are favorable

symbolic_reduction.selector_gap: No proof that both orbits (or either specified orbit subset) are selected for every eligible m,p
symbolic_reduction.coefficient_gap: No proof of the required sign for the selected coefficient difference over the full eligible region

tm_family.input_integrity: All 115 hashes listed in packets/C3-COMMON.json matched; packets/C3-T5.json listed no case-specific source files. The assigned coefficient direction was control/C3-TM-COEFFICIENT-DIRECTION.md.

graft.method: exact integer independent-set polynomial recursion f(M)=f(M-v)+z*f(M-N[v]) on vertex masks
graft.rank_convention: integer zero extension outside 0..alpha; x checked through alpha
graft.composition: attach one new pendant leaf at vertex 0 of T4
graft.scope: two exact trees at p=9; no universal claim
